run_compute_wheel_version: run the compute_wheel_version.py script to get the current wheel version from git tags or dev commits
get_tagged_version: get the tagged version string from the current git HEAD if an exact version tag exists
get_dev_version: get a development version string based on the base version and commit count
build_wheel_version_tag: build the wheel version using the tag source to return the exact version if a git tag matches HEAD
build_wheel_version_dev: build the wheel version using the dev source to return a version string with commit count
